items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: you know Eric Dolphy, Oliver Nelson, Charlie Mingus, just like a whole — the jazz cream of the crop, right?

ctx.x: Can you revisit that for me, because I found it really interesting.

Absolutely. Well see I had met, well let me back up a little bit — I did two albums for Bob Thiele, Impulse Records, actually Oliver Nelson, God bless him, he provided the opportunity for Bob Thiele, the founder or at least — yeah I think he was the founder of Impulse Records, which of course was the label for all of John Coltrane’s work until he passed, you know Eric Dolphy, Oliver Nelson, Charlie Mingus, just like a whole — the jazz cream of the crop, right? So this was such a privilege to be on this label. And…
was there and I swear this is like, in fact I’ve got the picture here somewhere, oh yeah it’s up there — if you could see that, it’s a little hard to see let me see if I could —
